criteria.note: Credential-backed GitHub Actions run succeeded with TIINGO_API_TOKEN supplied only through the secret environment and Authorization header.
Live evaluation retrieved January 1996 daily rows for AAPL, MSFT, and JPM; metadata reported still earlier start dates for long-lived names.
Five current large-cap symbols returned daily raw OHLCV plus Tiingo adjustment/corporate-action fields over the July-August 2026 probe window.
AAPL's 2020-08-31 four-for-one split and four 2024 cash-dividend dates were observed in live EOD responses. Broader event completeness remains to be measured.
Two identical AAPL bounded requests returned identical deterministic response hashes during the first live evaluation.
TWTR metadata remained retrievable with an end date of 2022-10-28. Systematic inactive/delisted universe characterization is still required.

Repeated development-triggered evaluations produced HTTP 429, proving the free-tier throttle is active. Quota-aware bounded execution, explicit rate-limit pause state, and resumable campaign control are now implemented, but the sustainable live operating envelope has not yet been demonstrated.

An explicit provider-specific transform now derives cumulative split-only multipliers from Tiingo split events and is covered by synthetic unit tests. A live AAPL known-split probe is prepared but was deferred after the 429 throttle was observed.

The current S&P 500 acquisition path now preserves source symbols while using explicit audited Tiingo transport mappings for BRK.B -> BRK-B and BF.B -> BF-B. Unknown dotted symbols fail closed and the full provider query-symbol set is collision-checked before any provider request. The current external 503-name snapshot still needs an operator preflight run.

Current-universe transport symbology is now explicit and separated from source identity, but the adapter still does not provide validated dated symbol-history reconstruction or permanent historical identity resolution suitable for a primary historical universe.
One delisted ticker is insufficient to establish complete inactive/delisted coverage or terminal-return treatment.

Starter is internal-use-only. Exact-byte raw preservation, checksum-verified durable receipts, and safe metadata-only campaign state are implemented without publishing licensed rows. A real durable private raw-data location and explicit licensing review are still required for operational baseline acquisition.

Quota-aware bounded backfill, monotonic persistent campaign state, durable raw receipts, and fail-closed completion checks are implemented. Representative multi-run S&P 500 acquisition on genuinely durable storage has not yet been demonstrated.
Tiingo has not yet been reconciled at representative scale against Alpha Vantage or another independent programmatic provider.

Transport, historical depth, current-universe transport symbology, rate-aware execution, checkpointing, and raw-evidence durability machinery are promising, but historical identity/symbol history, systematic delisting characterization, live split-only confirmation, licensing, durable operational acquisition, and representative secondary validation remain open.
